reports.title: Gross National Income Inventory (ESA 2010), 2010, The Netherlands
reports.description: Extended methodological description of sources and methods for Dutch national accounts under ESA 2010, prepared for Eurostat's GNI verification process; covers the production, expenditure and income approaches with process tables.

reports.title: Structural Business Statistics (SBS) / Production Statistics
reports.description: Annual survey-based statistics on enterprises, coordinated on the Statistical Business Register; the primary source for output, intermediate consumption and value added in the Dutch production approach to GDP.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
reports.description: Dutch balance-of-payments and IIP statistics, compiled by the central bank under BPM6/ESA 2010; named source for the property-income transition items from GDP to GNI, the same shape as Deutsche Bundesbank's role for Germany and Banca d'Italia's for Italy.

reports.title: Statistical Business Register (SBR) / General Business Register
reports.description: Register of legal units, enterprises and enterprise groups maintained by CBS from Chambers of Commerce, tax and other administrative sources; frames the SBS sampling frame and supplies NACE industry coding used in national accounts.

reports.title: National accounts (ESA 2010)
reports.description: Polish national accounts, compiled under ESA 2010. Documentation is thinner than the German/Dutch/Italian set — no public GNI Inventory at comparable granularity was found, a result later shown NOT to be a general newer-member pattern once Czechia and Croatia (also 2004/2013 accessions) came back as granular as the strongest-documented members.
